notes.title: The physical version of The Cub for Nintendo Switch is out now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, travellers of the abandoned Earth!  We’re thrilled to share that we discovered some treasures from before GEC among the ruins. It’s a supply of shiny and content-packed physical versions of The Cub Back To Earth Edition for Nintendo Switch!

However, first things first: we wanted to take a moment to thank you for your continued support on Steam. It’s a special moment for us; we couldn’t have done it without you. 

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160742/d2dbe064e04535ef7026f00836b2aeea7ddd650d.png

Going back to the subject, what can you expect from Back To Earth Edition?

🎮 Full game on cartridge
🖼️ An artbook that will take you on a creative journey among the changed surface of our home planet
📼 Digital version of the game’s soundtrack full of mysticism and mystery intertwined with nostalgia

Whether you’re double-dipping, have always wanted to play The Cub on a handheld, or have shared the adventure with your friend, thank you for being part of the journey.

🌎 Get Back To Earth Edition here:
https://meridiem-games.com/en/game/the-cub


[hr][/hr]

About The Cub

From the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Return to their whimsical, neon-lit apocalypse in a Jungle Book meets The Armageddon fusion. Parkour through the remains of humanity as a child being hunted, while catchy end-of-days tunes and curious survivor stories play on the radio.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941410/The_Cub/

notes.notes:

Get ready to immerse yourself in a journey across a neon-lit apocalypse Earth, filled with stories and clues, only to have it interrupted when the hunt for you begins.
